problem_solving_method: Built a comprehensive personal ledger web application utilizing Next.js App Router and reactive state management. Implemented multi-modal expense capture (structured typed notebook with autocomplete and Gemini OCR for receipt/bill parsing with uncertainty detection), daily burn-rate forecasting for month-end surplus/deficit projection, dynamic concrete written insights naming specific categories/amounts, savings pockets with forecast-constrained completion timelines, and Bangladesh bank standard compound DPS interest engine.

team_members.major_contribution: Implemented Gemini Vision OCR route with multi-key rotation for receipt parsing, build stabilization, and TypeScript type soundness across all components.

Implemented Core calculations (DPS compounding engine, burn-rate forecaster, written insight generator, recurring expense detector, what-if simulator), notebook parser with autocomplete, and state management.
Developed cohesive Material Design UI styling system, responsive dashboard layout, component polishing, and interactive simulation widgets.

major_design_decisions: Engineered DPS compound interest calculator strictly following Bangladesh banking standards (monthly deposit compounding with explicit interest rates).
Derived savings pocket completion dates directly from live rest-of-month surplus capacity rather than naive division.
Integrated real Gemini Vision OCR with multi-key rotation and uncertainty flagging alongside simulated fallback for offline reliability.
Designed high-efficiency dual-mode input: structured notebook parser with autocomplete and standard modal form.
known_limitations: Receipt OCR accuracy depends on image clarity and lighting conditions on camera captures.
Multi-user ledger synchronization is currently scoped to browser local storage and active sessions.
